patch_description:
This implementation replaces the purely random point set with a deterministic bottleneck-optimization search inside a fixed unit-area-equivalent simplex. Three points are held at the simplex vertices, guaranteeing a convex hull of known area, while the remaining ten points are optimized using a reproducible annealed local search.

The search uses all 286 triangle areas simultaneously. It combines a soft-min objective during exploration, which improves clusters of nearly-degenerate triangles rather than only the single worst one, with a final strict minimum-area objective. Candidate moves preferentially perturb points occurring in the currently smallest triangles, providing a targeted bottleneck-repair mechanism. The returned configuration is deterministic because all randomness is generated from a fixed seed.
